statements.t: “Initiating dosing in ANCHOR brings KRRO-121 a meaningful step closer to these patients, and we look forward to dosing participants with UCDs in the first half of 2027.

Both programs reflect what our OPERA platform is intended to do: correct disease at the level of RNA, with the precision to generate the protein of interest and convenience of subcutaneous administration.

dropped.t: "Adding KRRO-111 for AATD and being on track to add a third GalNAc-conjugated program this year is testament to the evolution of OPERA, our proprietary RNA editing platform to more efficiently nominate therapeutic candidates.
